I visited today, September 12, 2025, and was impressed by its blend of history and modern amenities. Located near the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) on Oyo Road, this 26-story icon, built in 1965 with cocoa export funds, stands at 105 meters, offering stunning views of Ibadan’s seven hills from its observation deck.

The ground-floor mini-mall buzzes with shops selling local crafts, fashion, and cocoa-themed souvenirs, perfect for visitors exploring Ibadan tourist attractions. Kokodome, the on-site restaurant and poolside bar, serves affordable Nigerian dishes like pounded yam and egusi soup, with a family-friendly swimming pool adding a recreational touch. The large car park makes access easy, even during peak hours, a huge plus in busy Dugbe.

The Odu’a Museum inside showcases Yoruba artifacts and cocoa cultivation history, a treat for cultural enthusiasts. While elevators could be faster and signage clearer, the site’s historical significance and vibrant energy make it a standout. If you look at my review history, you’ll see that I’m generally thoughtful, fair, and patient when issues arise. It takes an ongoing pattern of problems, combined with an unproductive management response, for me to feel compelled to write something like this.

This review is specific to the ReadySpaces location on Alma Ave in San Jose, and does not reflect on other ReadySpaces locations.

My experience at this Alma Ave facility has been disappointing, primarily due to management practices rather than the concept of the space itself.

The warehouse units at this location are very cold, especially for anyone working long hours or late into the evening. Despite this, there was never any written or verbal notice that space heaters were prohibited. That restriction does not appear in the license agreement or the facility rules provided for this site. When electrical issues occurred, the response from regional management focused on attributing fault to individual tenants rather than addressing infrastructure capacity or clearly communicating policy expectations.

Access to shared resources at this location has also been an issue. I was told multiple times that I did not have working access to the conference room reservation system, which made it impossible to reserve the room properly. At the same time, the conference room was being used for extended periods late into the night by the same unvetted group, effectively blocking access for other members. When shared spaces can be occupied indefinitely without oversight, it creates an inequitable environment.

I also raised concerns about non-business activity occurring in the facility during late hours at this location, based on direct observations. Surveillance cameras are present, yet these concerns were not meaningfully addressed, which raised questions about consistency in enforcement and after-hours oversight.

The most frustrating part has been the response from regional management overseeing this site. Communication from Ryan, the Regional Manager, came across as defensive and dismissive rather than collaborative or solution-oriented. Concerns were framed as tenant responsibility instead of being acknowledged as operational issues affecting members’ ability to work safely and productively.

For clarity and fairness, this review has no bearing on Property Manager Jonathon at this location, who has consistently been helpful, responsive, and compassionate within the limits of his role.

I would strongly encourage prospective tenants considering the Alma Ave ReadySpaces location, particularly womem, to ask very direct questions about temperature conditions, after-hours monitoring, shared space enforcement, and how tenant concerns are handled before committing. Transparency, consistency, and professionalism matter just as much as square footage, and those elements have been lacking in my experience at this specific location.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmNMYTu0mxu_CXpxlGSCt5GbUQgIG-c0VSV2E3JjWSCIkP8lEzyxeqpaV6FYrNLd2UOEJgLpHw7Vvd0eIfy3a_LL3nnNaQxld_u5SCfOffEPB8RmInKnweMocqoR_EsHuivEwU8OioivpozG=k-no","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmMYC9OW8UhHnUF60u2UwGkiTk6o60EY8c78HY64YciObY6GYTuI0tots33j2XpkK7oCo-ihco6ob7CNbTim0G12HQixua4OOlfKSgKhrsnSNYATSLcZmmUhu8TccZ4AR2HL5TnNBo36QAKP=k-no","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmNXJCagbobghugHTZwREzOnRKB2jGpN00CSi5BU3uG7OlgOsPNlZes--G5tVSoiFzXN0bLV8SDvqqsqNrRZtgNEik_6C6yemBULqzk0w26rJ613_qHinWOvhtY2kUc5BL_WrcYmkP6P88dY=k-no","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmOW_Q8SQbTAinaTRBQM6ddtlvA8bIZQtPJb07W5dIzwEGIDRq9zQvhfek43R9jjyd1NYXEhuHhAxB0Xp23TZjuI3xsFEb-oR6rm6ElTaRdPMakr5g0jyg3naNuoeYPA4NSSJ-UmecgsTyg=k-no","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmOOl8j8Cs-GMNSuAh8xnydMDqYV4LxLArtiklckR34_XsoDm8MSafZhejFPqENXujrRh-zSXZA9yZ8zvVg-yk8X9Aft_xEDXGFiinJ6WntbD0W1IipwQAeyIowiiRCrIkM7Yc8DjIQC9Y4=k-no"],"When":"Edited 7 months ago","review_id":"Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21NelJXZ3liemRUVUVWSmVrUlZiMk5CT0U1QlFXYxAB","source":"Google","rating_scale":5,"rating_float":1,"author_url":"https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/109363153315744882913/reviews?hl=en-US","posted_at_unix_micros":1763242303823628,"updated_at_unix_micros":1768954084365031,"language":"en","translated_lang":"","text_original":"I rarely leave negative reviews.
